articleMarkdown:
# Ten of Pentacles: Making What You Build Usable by Others

Lasting stability rests on arrangements people can share and continue to maintain.

Keywords: Continuity · Community · Legacy

Upright at a glance: Organise an established foundation so that others can carry it forward.

Reversed at a glance: An appearance of stability may cover disagreement; an old arrangement needs fresh discussion.

The Ten of Pentacles does not show one person clutching ten coins. Discs lie across the whole scene, among an older person, adults, a child and dogs. Much of what accumulates belongs to an entire way of living together.

## An arch connects generations and a home

An older white-haired person sits in the left foreground, wearing a robe crowded with richly coloured designs. Two pale dogs are near the person's hand and knees. A child on the right is only partly visible, with one hand on a dog. Two adults stand together in the middle distance, one turned away from us and one toward the companion.

They stand beneath a large arch. Houses and a square tower are visible beyond, with a shield-shaped emblem on the building at the left. Ten pentacles overlay the whole picture: some cover architecture and others clothing. They are not stacked in a single chest. The image also does not establish every relationship among the people present. [View the card image](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pents10.jpg)

## Family matters and archives appear in Waite's list

Waite describes an archway leading to a house and domain, noting the two adults, child, dogs and older figure in front. Alongside wealth, his upright meanings include family matters, archives, ancestry and the family home, already extending the subject across generations.

His reversed list is mixed, including chance and loss as well as gifts and a pension. This article does not use it to predict family events. It develops a modern question about whether shared arrangements can last. Here, community can include chosen family and collaborative groups. [Check Waite’s text](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktpe10.htm)

## Upright Make stability something others can use

The upright card can focus on what has accumulated: shared experience, reliable relationships, reusable methods or a place where people can return and rest. One value of accumulation is that others need not begin from nothing every time.

Leaving experience available takes more than “I will explain later.” Where are the materials, who knows how to use them, who handles maintenance, and how will changes be discussed? Such arrangements turn continuity into an actual capacity rather than an attractive vision.

## Reversed Hear different needs within the group

The reversal can ask whether “we have always done it this way” has become a refusal to talk. Established habits may help some people while leaving others with long-standing invisible work. Put responsibility and participation on the table to see what needs adjusting.

Also notice whether one person alone holds essential knowledge: where information is stored, who to contact or how a process works. If that person cannot continue, everyone may struggle. Prepare a handover before a crisis forces it.

## Put continuity into practical arrangements

When a team project closes, organise instructions, common questions and unfinished tasks so the next person has a way in. People sharing a home can periodically discuss cleaning, repairs and visitors instead of relying on someone to quietly fill every gap.

At a family gathering, ask older relatives which stories they would like to preserve and listen to how younger members want to take part. Keeping shared memories does not require everyone to follow the same path in life.

## Practice Make a small handover

Choose an everyday task that only you know well. Write the minimum information someone else would need and ask that person to try it. Add answers to the questions the trial reveals. Being usable matters more than appearing comprehensive.

## Common misreading

The Ten of Pentacles guarantees neither an inheritance, a happy marriage nor a prosperous family background. It does not require sacrificing personal wishes to family expectations. It is better used to ask who benefits from an arrangement, who maintains it and how it can continue.

## Sources and image

The image was drawn by Pamela Colman Smith. The source manuscript was based on inspection of the standard 500px thumbnail listed on the file page; version details come from the [Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pents10.jpg).

The historical discussion follows [this card’s English entry](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktpe10.htm) in Part III, Section 2 of A. E. Waite’s The Pictorial Key to the Tarot. The source is the English transcription labelled [1911] by the Internet Sacred Text Archive. A physical 1910 first edition was not checked for this batch. The everyday situations, questions and exercises are original modern reflections, not direct translations of Waite’s book.

sourceRecord.title: 星币十 让积累有人接得住
sourceRecord.oneLiner: 长久的安定，来自可以共同使用和继续维护的安排。
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 把已经形成的基础整理好，让更多人能够接续。
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 表面的稳固盖住了分歧，旧安排需要重新商量。
sourceRecord.hook: 星币十不是一个人抱着十枚钱币。圆盘散落在整个场景上，老人、成年人、孩子和狗都在其中，提醒我们：许多积累属于一套共同生活。

sections.title: 拱门把几代人与一处住所连起来
paragraphs: 前景左侧坐着白发老人，衣袍布满颜色浓重的图样；两只浅色狗靠近他的手与膝前。右边的孩子只露出一部分身体，一只手放在狗身上。中景两名成年人站在一起，一位背对观者，一位转向身旁的人。
他们处在一道大拱门之下，门外能见房屋和方形高塔，左侧建筑有盾形纹章。十枚星币覆盖在整个画面上，有的挡住建筑，有的叠在人物衣服之前。它们并非排在同一只箱子里；画面也没有证明在场者之间的每一种关系。 [查看本篇牌面](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pents10.jpg)

sections.title: 家务与档案也在 Waite 的词表里
paragraphs: Waite 把场景描述为进入住所与领地的拱门，提及两名成年人、孩子、两只狗和前景老人。正位含义除财富外，还有家庭事务、档案、出身与家族住所，已经把主题扩展到跨代生活。
逆位词表则很杂，包含偶然性、损失等说法，也有赠与或养老金。本篇不据此预告家族事件，而是发展“共同安排能否持续”的现代反思；这里的共同体也可以是自己选择的家人与合作群体。 [核对 Waite 原文](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktpe10.htm)

sections.title: 正位 让稳定可以被继续使用
paragraphs: 正位可以关注已经沉淀下来的东西：共享的经验、可信赖的关系、可复用的方法，或一处大家能回来休息的地方。积累的意义，常常体现在别人不用每次从零开始。
把经验留得下来，需要比口头说“以后再讲”更具体。资料放在哪里，谁知道怎么使用，日常维护由谁承担，遇到变化如何商量？这些安排让延续成为真实能力，而不只是好看的愿景。

sections.title: 逆位 听见共同体里的不同需要
paragraphs: 逆位可检查“我们一直如此”有没有变成拒绝讨论的理由。稳定的习惯可能帮助一些人，也可能让另一些人长期承担看不见的工作。把责任与参与权放到桌面上，才知道需要调整什么。
也要留意共同基础是否只掌握在一个人手中：只有他知道资料位置、联系方法或操作流程。一旦无法继续承担，大家就会很被动。补好交接，不必等危机出现。

sections.title: 把长久放进具体安排
paragraphs: 团队项目收尾时，整理操作说明、常见问题和未完成事项，让后来接手的人有路可循。共同居住的人可以定期讨论清洁、维修和访客安排，减少依靠某个人默默补位。
家庭聚会中，询问长辈愿意留下哪些故事，也听取年轻成员怎样参与。保留共同记忆，不必要求所有人沿用同一种生活路线。

sections.title: 练习 做一次小交接
paragraphs: 选一件只有你熟悉的日常事务，写出其他人接手所需的最少信息，并请对方实际试一次。将试用时遇到的疑问补进去。能被另一人使用，比文档看起来齐全更重要。

sections.title: 容易看错的地方
paragraphs: 星币十不保证继承遗产、婚姻圆满或家境优越，也不要求为了家族期待牺牲个人意愿。它更适合帮助我们思考，现有安排让谁受益、由谁维持，又怎样继续。
